# Branch 06 evidence: public case study

## Purpose

Turn the verified vertical into a clear public demonstration without adding a
new capability or expanding its claims.

## Public proof

- a complete README led by the decision, working result, and limitations;
- an original 1280 × 640 social-preview asset;
- a browser-captured 1440 × 1050 image of the real local Streamlit result;
- concise workflow and architecture diagrams rendered by GitHub Mermaid;
- one public case-study narrative and one five-minute demo script;
- explicit separation of rule-baseline evidence from live-model evidence; and
- the visible six-branch reasoning history.

## Completion gate

This branch is ready only when both binary assets match the provenance
manifest, the interface image is visually inspected, all README links resolve
locally, public-boundary scans cover the current tree and reachable history,
the complete Branch 05 quality gate still passes, and the working tree is clean
after the final commit.
